Log In BOOK NOW ACTIVITIES AND IMAGES OF LAKESIDE HOMESTAY CAMPGROUND Phone and Zalo: 0989985805 Lakeside homestay Dong Do lake was built in 2009 with the original purpose of being a weekend house. Currently, the Lakeside homestay Dong Do lake campsite has been upgraded and renovated into a private campsite and homestay with an area of about 10,000m2 of pine forest over 30 years old and 150m long lake surface. The scenery and weather of the campsite are like a miniature Da Lat near Hanoi. We provide full camping services with tents including Mongolian tents and high-class glamping tents under roofs. In addition, we also provide some homestay rooms for individual guests or groups to stay during the day or overnight upon request. Lakeside homestay campsite Dong Do lake also manages and owns the Like Peninsula campsite 300m away. You can choose the camping site as requested. With the advantage of owning the land, we wish to build a beautiful and professional campsite near Hanoi but the price is always the most competitive to serve customers. CAMPGROUND SERVICES Lakeside homestay serves beef noodle soup, egg and sausage instant noodles for overnight campers. Lakeside homestay also serves a full range of BBQ, chicken hotpot, beef, fish and other local dishes. We also serve coffee, soft drinks and other alcoholic beverages. In addition to renting tents of all kinds, we have a full range of other camping equipment such as tables, chairs, decorative lights, fans, grills, charcoal, alcohol... We also rent many different types of boats from kayaks, inflatable boats, SUPs, sailboats. BBQ SET, CHICKEN, BEEF, FISH HOT POT AND POPULAR DISHES professional fire and bbq area SERVING COFFEE AND ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES bike rental recommendation KITCHEN AND COOKWARE FOR RENT The toilet is always clean and made of unique wood. 24/7 gas hot and cold shower As a small family campsite our customer service is always prompt, fast and friendly. Guests are welcome to bring their own camping gear and food and drinks to the campsite at no additional charge. We guarantee to help you order food at restaurants near the campsite or other outside services completely free of charge. Address Contact (Ms. Minh) to deposit 30% of the money to complete the booking.
